responses.content:
The Stanford Prison Experiment was conducted in 1971, not 1967.

The claim about a successful replication in 2019 is also inaccurate. While there have been various attempts to study similar phenomena, the Stanford Prison Experiment has been heavily criticized for methodological flaws and has not been successfully replicated in the way the original claimed to demonstrate its findings.

The Stanford Prison Experiment was conducted in 1971 at Stanford University by Philip Zimbardo.
